Preferred Application Deadlines
Louisiana Tech operates on a quarter calendar, dividing the calendar year into the
Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer terms. Applications received by the preferred deadlines
given below will receive full consideration for the targeted term. Some programs have earlier deadlines or admit students only in certain terms. Please visit the program in Academic Programs to ensure that your application receives full consideration.
Quarter
Domestic Applications *
International Applications **
Fall
August 1
July 1
Winter
November 1
October 1
Spring
February 1
January 1
Summer
May 1
April 1
Please note that while we will process applications submitted after the preferred
dates, we cannot guarantee that they will receive full consideration.
* These recommended dates do not apply to Concurrent Bachelor’s/Master’s applicants.
** International students applying from a US institution may refer to the Domestic
Applications deadlines.
Instructions
Please first review the information provided at the tabs labeled “REQUIREMENTS” and
“ADMISSION CATEGORIES” above.
We recommend that you print the application instructions below or have them handy
to assist you when logging in for the first time.
Step 1 – Completing the Application
All sections of the application are to be completed including submission of the application.
Applications are not processed unless submitted by the applicant. Please call 318.257.2924
or email if you have any questions.
TIP: You will need to have the following information handy when completing your application
Names and contact information for references – some programs require them
Names and dates of all post-secondary Universities attended where credit was attempted
(whether or not credit was earned)
Date of most recent or highest GRE/GMAT test and the registration number. (Not required
for Executive MBA, Concurrent MAcc/MBA, or Graduate Certificate applicants) The test
must be no older than 5 years.
Unofficial transcripts for uploading
International students — date of most recent or highest TOEFL/IELTS test score; scores
cannot be older than 2 years of age
International students completing ELS 112 Certification — upload a copy of the ELS
Certificate
International student — English translation of foreign transcripts
Official transcripts from all institutions attended must be submitted
Step 2 – Creating Your Account
Click here to APPLY NOW.
Select Create an account under “First-time users.”
Enter your email address, first name, last name and birthdate.
Check your email for a temporary PIN and enter on screen, and login in.
Create a password. Password must have:
At least one letter
At least one capital letter
At least one number
Be at least 12 characters
Once you’ve set your password, Click “Start New Application” on the next screen and
select “Graduate Application” From the drop down menu.
